mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.article_id, a.title AS article_title, c.user_id, COALESCE(u.username, '访客') AS username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.parent_id, NULL AS parent_content, c.content, c.ip_address, c.status, c.create_time FROM comments c LEFT JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.id LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, COALESCE(u.username, '访客') AS username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.parent_id, NULL AS reply_to_username, c.content, c.create_time FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.article_id = #{articleId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT c.id, c.article_id, c.user_id, COALESCE(u.username, '访客') AS username, u.avatar AS user_avatar, c.parent_id, COALESCE(pu.username, '访客') AS reply_to_username, c.content, c.create_time FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN comments pc ON c.parent_id = pc.id LEFT JOIN users pu ON pc.user_id = pu.id WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT TO_CHAR(c.create_time, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM comments c WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status != 3 AND c.create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(c.create_time, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC
